findings.result: Changes temporary maximum HP; clamps current HP only if over new maximum. Does not add HP when maximum increases. Later same-category effect overwrites.
Temporary negative signed amount represents percent of base HP, max calculation rounds via 0x1000480e0; fixed dungeon HP can override, not included by offline normal context.
All-attribute shield clears attribute-specific skill shields; attribute shield clears all skill shield slots. RCV type50 attr5 stores its multiplier and duration.
Each enemy uses current dungeon pointer for stat multipliers. Enemy subobject+88 attack derives from catalog curve then dungeon scale.
Enemy HP/ATK/DEF curve blocks at catalog+104/+128/+152; min/max u64, power float; enemy maximum level u16+176. Level1=min; later levels round min+(max-min)*pow((level-1)/(maxLevel-1),power).
Dungeon string options3/4/5 contain HP/ATK/DEF ten-thousandths. The dump lacks options; scale inferred from matching live observations remains explicit provenance.

Enemy attribute change chooses one of first five supplied attributes unequal to current attribute. If all candidates match current, leaf is infeasible. 150% attached records on floors13-15 are therefore conditional on a prior attribute change.
Raw attack percent/enrage float32 then signed round. Skill/leader/heart-L/resist layers remain ordered. Offline team shield product is an estimate, not exact native assembled defense proof.

guide_storage: Importable non-executable JSON, matched by dungeon/subDungeon plus optional enemy checks, separately saved and reloaded; no rebuild for new dungeon notes.
